text_block_list.text:
The Kokura Kinen... The day has arrived 
for the race, featuring conditions 
tailored nicely to Nice Nature, like the 
distance.

However, precisely because of these 
favorable conditions, Nice Nature felt all 
the more pressured, thinking she 
absolutely couldn't lose.

With nervous tension lingering, Nice 
Nature made her way to the paddock. There, 
cheers showered down upon her from the 
folks of the Kokura shopping district.

Hearing the voices of the people from the 
shopping district, she changed her mindset 
and headed toward the race... determined 
to meet their expectations.
